localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear pixel streaks detected against the dark dorsal background of the visible pectoral fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent leading-edge tubercles (rounded protuberances) visible along the superior boundary of the pectoral fin segments.
